title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
summary: Inertia expects its full-scale commercial power plant will use ten fuel pellets every second. “By reducing the latency of this step, you’ve made your facility smaller; you’ve made the whole thing faster, the whole thing more efficient,” Lawson said.
